_comment: Public/commercial baseline detectors + our quantization variants for the bake-off. To add a model, append an entry here (no code change). 'weights' paths are placeholders -- CHANGE THEM to wherever you actually keep these checkpoints (relative to the bake-off evaluator container's working directory, or an absolute path of your own; they must be readable by that container, which mounts your dataset root, a scratch/output dir, /runs, and the training-data root incl. the quant/ output dir). This file previously shipped with the maintainers' own private absolute filesystem paths baked in -- never copy those back in; use your own. 'mode' may be full|crop|both. The ours_*_onnx variants are produced by export/quantize.py; FP16 ONNX is the primary NVIDIA deliverable, INT8 QDQ ONNX is the lighter/faster edge+paper datapoint.

baselines.name: ours_fp16_onnx
baselines.training_data: curated YOLO26 (FP16 ONNX — primary NVIDIA deliverable)
